passage.text: It's Friday night, and Emma and Nam are at home with a big bowl of popcorn.
passage.reading: ɪts ˈfraɪdeɪ ˈnaɪt, ənd ˈɛmə ənd ˈnɑːm ər ət ˈhoʊm wɪð ə ˈbɪɡ ˈboʊl əv ˈpɑːpkɔːrn.

passage.text: "What are you in the mood for?" Emma says.
passage.reading: ˈwʌt ər juː ɪn ðə ˈmuːd ˈfɔːr? ˈɛmə ˈsɛz.

passage.text: "Something funny," Nam says. "It was a long week."
passage.reading: ˈsʌmθɪŋ ˈfʌni, ˈnɑːm ˈsɛz. ɪt wʌz ə ˈlɔːŋ ˈwiːk.

passage.text: "How about this Korean drama?" Emma says. "It has a great twist at the end."
passage.reading: ˈhaʊ əˈbaʊt ðɪs kəˈriːən ˈdrɑːmə? ˈɛmə ˈsɛz. ɪt ˈhæz ə ˈɡreɪt ˈtwɪst ət ði ˈɛnd.

passage.text: "No, I can't stand sad dramas," Nam says. "They always make me cry."
passage.reading: ˈnoʊ, aɪ ˈkænt ˈstænd ˈsæd ˈdrɑːməz, ˈnɑːm ˈsɛz. ðeɪ ˈɔːlweɪz ˈmeɪk miː ˈkraɪ.

passage.text: "OK. What about this British comedy?" Emma says.
passage.reading: oʊˈkeɪ. ˈwʌt əˈbaʊt ðɪs ˈbrɪtɪʃ ˈkɑːmədi? ˈɛmə ˈsɛz.

passage.text: "It has six episodes, and they're only twenty minutes long."
passage.reading: ɪt ˈhæz ˈsɪks ˈɛpəsoʊdz, ənd ðɛr ˈoʊnli ˈtwɛnti ˈmɪnɪts ˈlɔːŋ.

passage.text: "Perfect!" Nam says. "Let's watch the first episode."
passage.reading: ˈpɜːrfɪkt! ˈnɑːm ˈsɛz. ˈlɛts ˈwɑːtʃ ðə ˈfɜːrst ˈɛpəsoʊd.

passage.text: After the first episode, they're both laughing.
passage.reading: ˈæftər ðə ˈfɜːrst ˈɛpəsoʊd, ðɛr ˈboʊθ ˈlæfɪŋ.

passage.text: "Of course! But we need more popcorn!"
passage.reading: əv ˈkɔːrs! bʌt wiː ˈniːd ˈmɔːr ˈpɑːpkɔːrn!
